name: run
algorithm: n runs of the program itself with the argument child, which writes 64 bytes to standard output and exits 0; standard output and standard error captured, standard input the null device, each exit waited for (tests/bench-lanes/std-proc2/README.md).
notes: Written by std-proc2 (status/std-proc2.md, M6 session 1) over the public proc.Run. Every column counts a failed run or a non-zero exit as a fail (session 4, G-PROC2-R6) and starts the program by the path of its own executable.
Zig column (session 2): std.process.run, whose Io.File.MultiReader drains both pipes at once, standard input ignored.

skip.c: no std facility: ISO C has no process creation or capture (posix_spawn and CreateProcessW are OS APIs, not the C library), so no hand-written OS code stands in (plan/06-m6.md 4.1; G-PROC2-R5: the old column drained its pipes one after the other and skipped the handle list Mk builds)
